about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Low Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, O Lord our God, that Thou wouldst make the most holy mysteries, which Thou hast bestowed as a safeguard of our restoration, a remedy for us both present and future. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
